North of the Beqa'ot - Tammun road ... 70-90 leveled "pools"
features.subtype: 70-90 leveled agricultural 'pools' with low earthen ramps (50-dunam field)

notes: s2f3: the entry calls them "pools" (in quotation marks) and suggests a special crop (rice, sugar cane) or fish; coded as pool with pool_def yes because the source calls them pools and Fig. 293 shows each well over 3 m a side. Its direction is from the road (relative_to other); Fig. 293 (bar 0-25 m) shows the field N to NNE of the hatched 'Roman-Byzantine Village', but the village is only partly drawn, so the unit point cannot be placed and no plan position is given. No graves in the entry.
